venue.name: Shopping Mueller Joinville
venue.address: R. Visc. de Taunay, 235 - Centro - Centro, Joinville - SC, 89201-420

items.information:
(BR) **Bem-vindos à primeira competição oficial em Joinville!**
Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações abaixo em "Requisitos de inscrição". Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste vídeo. https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=x8SHEX_vbvaot-7_
Favor ler o Regulamento da WCA antes da competição.
Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para o feminino e para iniciantes na modalidade 'Cubo 3x3x3'. A premiação das modalidades extra-oficiais será feita de acordo com a classificação do competidor na competição. (não será definida pela primeira rodada)
** Inscrições no local serão aceitas apenas para a modalidade 3x3.**


(EN) **Welcome to the first official competition in Joinville!**
Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information below in "Registration requirements". If you have any problems with how to register, take a look at this video. https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=x8SHEX_vbvaot-7_
Please read the WCA Regulations before the competition.
We will have awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards for women and for beginners in the '3x3x3 Cube' event. The unofficial events awards will be given according to the competitor's position in the competition (It will not be based on the first round results.)
** Registrations at the venue will only be accepted for the 3x3 event.**

items.name: Big Cubes Athens 2024
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc0ZpIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--d2ad4e4f29cfeee447dd4662438ee1c08da476ee/image.png)

Mετά τη συναρπαστική πορεία του 'Athens Cubing Starter Pack 2024' η δράση συνεχίζεται με τον επόμενο διαγωνισμό της σειράς, αυτή τη φορά με έμφαση στα μεγάλα παζλ! Καλωσορίζουμε τους παίκτες στο δεύτερο μέρος αυτής της συναρπαστικής περιπέτειας, όπου τα παζλ υψηλής δυσκολίας θα κλέψουν την παράσταση. Από τon 4x4x4, μέχρι τoν 7x7x7. Ο διαγωνισμός αυτός είναι σχεδιασμένος να δοκιμάσει τις δεξιότητες και την υπομονή των πιο έμπειρων cubers. Μην χάσετε την ευκαιρία να δείτε και να συμμετάσχετε σε αυτό το θέαμα δεξιοτεχνίας και αντοχής, όπου το μέγεθος και η πολυπλοκότητα πραγματικά μετράνε. Ετοιμάστε τους κύβους σας για μια ακόμα πρόκληση στον κόσμο του cubing!

Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. 

Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. 

[Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg)

[Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων του Ρούμπικ.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x5KaXXoh7XI)

After the exciting run of 'Athens Cubing Starter Pack 2024' the action continues with the next competition in the series, this time with an emphasis on big puzzles! We welcome players to the second part of this thrilling adventure, where high-difficulty puzzles will steal the show. From the impressive 4x4x4s to the complex 7x7x7s and other equally challenging sizes, this competition is designed to test the skills and patience of the most experienced cubers. Don't miss the opportunity to witness and participate in this spectacle of dexterity and endurance, where size and complexity truly matter. Prepare your cubes for another challenge in the world of cubing!

Please read the following tab very carefully to find all the necessary information.

Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs.
Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

items.name: Saratoga Springs Newcomers 2024
items.information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competition Procedures](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SaratogaSpringsNewcomers2024#36860-competition-procedures) and [New Competitor FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SaratogaSpringsNewcomers2024#36861-new-competitor-faq) tab.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcHhpIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--0030a62d70c3135d4afc414666717da46eabefef/SaratogaSpringsCubikon.jpg)

Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! Due to venue capacity limits, we ask that no more than 1 guest per cuber during the morning hours. No guest limit after Noon. No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating.

Please provide adult supervision for children under 12 years of age.

This competition is a part of the WCA Newcomer Month initiative. Please refer to the WCA Newcomer Month Information tab for more information.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcUJOIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--573fdf538a21acdaa5aaf068feb5551af8f5c1df/Logo_big.png)
# This competition is in celebration of WCA Newcomer Month! This competition is catered to all speedcubing newcomers and we welcome you to register for this competition!
- Bay Area Speedcubin' is proud to partner with [West Coast Cubing LLC](https://www.facebook.com/WestCoastCubingLLC) and [CubersLive](https://www.facebook.com/CubersLive) to bring another competition to Northern California with a **focus on the live-stream and first-time competitor experience!**
- This competition will be testing the new revolutionary score-taking technology, **TimeBase!** We will be using traditional scorecards but will be offering a brand-new, paperless scoretaking experience for all registered competitors!
- This competition will be running a **Stationary Solve Station** set-up!
-  *If we run ahead of schedule, we will start first round events no earlier than 20 minutes, so please show up at least 20 minutes before your first event.*
- We will be assigning judging assignments to competitors for the group before or after their own competing groups. Please check your personal competitor cards when we assign them a week before the competition date for relevant info.

# Competitors can bring 1 guest for free to the competition! If they would like to bring a 2nd or more guests, we are charging $5 per extra guest via paypal at the front desk. Spectators not associated with the competition may still pay the $5 fee to attend and watch the competition up close and personal!
